from glom.core import glom

target = {
    'teams': [
        {'name': 'red', 'members': [{'name': 'Ada', 'score': 7}, {'name': 'Bob', 'score': 3}]},
        {'name': 'blue', 'members': [{'name': 'Cyd', 'score': 5}, {'name': 'Dan', 'score': 9}]},
    ],
    'archive': {'teams': []},
}
members = glom(target, ('teams', ['members']))
flat = [user['name'] for group in members for user in group if user['score'] >= 5]

print(members)
print(flat)
print({name: len(name) for name in flat})
